question: How many iPhones did Apple sell in FY2023, and what is its revenue guidance for next year?

answer.summary: Apple's FY2023 iPhone revenue was $200.58B [F00279], down from $205.49B in FY2022 [F00280], a decline of -$4.91B (-2.4%) [F00279/F00280]. iPhone accounted for 52.3% of total FY2023 revenues of $383.29B [F00013/F00279]. The retrieved evidence does not contain iPhone unit sales (number of iPhones sold) for FY2023. The retrieved evidence also does not contain any forward-looking revenue guidance for the next fiscal year. iPhone revenue decline contributed 44% of the total revenue change of -$11.04B (-2.8%) [F00014/F00279].

iPhone revenue decline of -$4.91B (-2.4%) was the second-largest product contributor, accounting for 44% of the total change [F00279/F00280/F00014]
Services offset the decline with +$7.07B (+9.1%), moving against the total change [F00010/F00011]
